schema.text: Is there enough safe space to wait before crossing or to stop and rest?

options.text: A place exists, but it is too small
No space to wait or rest is needed here

en.#A place exists, but it is too small: A place exists, but it is too small

it.#Is there enough safe space to wait befo: C'è abbastanza spazio sicuro per aspettare prima di attraversare o per fermarsi a riposare?
it.#A place exists, but it is too small: C'è uno spazio, ma è troppo piccolo
it.#No space to wait or rest is needed here: Qui non serve uno spazio per aspettare o riposarsi

fr.#Is there enough safe space to wait befo: Y a-t-il assez d'espace sûr pour attendre avant de traverser ou pour s'arrêter et se reposer ?
fr.#A place exists, but it is too small: Il existe un espace, mais il est trop petit
fr.#No space to wait or rest is needed here: Aucun espace pour attendre ou se reposer n’est nécessaire ici

de.#Is there enough safe space to wait befo: Gibt es genug sicheren Platz, um vor dem Überqueren zu warten oder anzuhalten und sich auszuruhen?
de.#A place exists, but it is too small: Es gibt einen Platz, aber er ist zu klein
de.#No space to wait or rest is needed here: Hier wird kein Platz zum Warten oder Ausruhen benötigt

tr.#Is there enough safe space to wait befo: Karşıya geçmeden önce beklemek veya durup dinlenmek için yeterli güvenli alan var mı?
tr.#A place exists, but it is too small: Bir yer var, ancak çok küçük
tr.#No space to wait or rest is needed here: Burada beklemek veya dinlenmek için alan gerekmiyor

fa.#Is there enough safe space to wait befo: آیا فضای امن کافی برای انتظار پیش از عبور یا توقف و استراحت وجود دارد؟
fa.#A place exists, but it is too small: جایی وجود دارد، اما خیلی کوچک است
fa.#No space to wait or rest is needed here: در اینجا فضایی برای انتظار یا استراحت لازم نیست

hu.#Is there enough safe space to wait befo: Van-e elég biztonságos hely várakozni az átkelés előtt, vagy megállni pihenni?
hu.#No space to wait or rest is needed here: Itt nincs szükség helyre a várakozáshoz vagy pihenéshez

ar.#Is there enough safe space to wait befo: هل توجد مساحة آمنة كافية للانتظار قبل العبور أو للتوقف والاستراحة؟
ar.#No space to wait or rest is needed here: لا حاجة هنا إلى مساحة للانتظار أو الاستراحة
